source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of major toxic materials (PDF 222).

blocks.text: Bohat se zehreele materials mahol mein shamil ho rahe hain; plastics aur heavy metals do bari fikrein hain. Yeh apni mufeed khasiyaton ki wajah se wasee taur par use hote hain, lekin in ke taveel muddat ke asraat jaan-leva ho sakte hain.
Heavy metals: lead (Pb), mercury (Hg) aur cadmium (Cd) electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein aam hain. Yeh zameeni pani mein ja sakti hain, jahan se jandaron mein muntaqil hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Pb, Hg, Cd: 'electronics, batteries, fluorescent lights' se teer 'groundwater' tak, aur wahan se teer 'living organisms' tak.
blocks.caption: Heavy metals jandaron tak kaise pohanchti hain (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Plastics: bohat se plastics mein phthalates ya bisphenol A (BPA) jaise zehreele additives hote hain jo hormones mein mudakhlat kar sakte hain. Microplastics ab samandaron, mitti aur khane tak mein milte hain, aur insani zindagi aur ecosystems par taveel asar rakhte hain. Insanon mein microplastics ke carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) hone ka shuba hai, lekin yeh abhi sabit nahi hua.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke insanon mein microplastics 'carcinogenic paye gaye'. Microplastics insani jism mein paye gaye hain aur un ke sehat par asraat par tehqeeq (research) jari hai, lekin yeh sabit nahi hua ke yeh insanon mein cancer paida karte hain. Is liye sabaq likhta hai ke in ke carcinogenic hone ka shuba (suspected) hai.

blocks.prompt: Lead, mercury aur cadmium aam taur par kahan milte hain?
blocks.explanation: Electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein.

items: Heavy metals Pb, Hg, Cd: electronics, batteries, fluorescent lights; zameeni pani tak.
Plastic additives (phthalates, BPA) hormones par asar; microplastics har jagah.
